observations: A broad rectangular head shape fills most of the canvas against a flat red background; two spiral-wound eye forms sit inside separate rectangular sockets, the left darker and greener, the right lighter with more blue.
Neon yellow-green and cyan loop marks extend outward from both sides of the head, contrasting with the dense warm orange, pink, and red line-work packed across the face interior.
The lower jaw is open, showing five blocky white teeth on the upper row and a partial lower row; a zigzag lattice of thin colored lines fills the gap between the two jaw sections.
reading: A wide, flat-fronted head pushes close to the picture edge, leaving only a strip of red on each side. The spiral eyes — two tight coils, one greener and one bluer — read as alert or strained. Dense warm line-work across the face gives way at the edges to loose neon loops that feel almost casual by comparison. The open jaw, with its blocky white teeth, tips the mood toward something loud or unguarded.
contextAngle: Within the owned nifty-faces subset, title neighbors are nnxyz nifty faces #44 and nnxyz nifty faces #46. Title order and recorded creation order align for these three owned works. Gaps exist elsewhere in the family; this alignment cannot be extended to the full catalogue.

connections.reason: Both show a wide face with spiral or radial eye forms and a row of white teeth low in the composition, but #44 sets these against a dark ground with looser outer edges, while #45 packs the same elements into a red-saturated, nearly edge-to-edge field.

nnxyz nifty faces #46 shares the rectangular face structure and white tooth block, but replaces the red ground and warm line density with a blue field and sparser, more open line work — a direct color-ground contrast within the owned subset.

lookingQuestion: The neon loops at the sides of the head use a different line weight and color temperature than the dense warm marks covering the face — where exactly does that shift happen, and does it follow the edge of the rectangular head shape or cut across it?
ambiguities: The nnotb #4 comparison image shows no strong formal parallel beyond shared line density; it was inspected but not selected as a connection.
Title order and recorded creation order coincide for this work and its immediate neighbors in the owned subset, but gaps exist elsewhere in the family.
